formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the WETH allowance that the owner (the signer) gives to the spender to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance and stays usable until the spender uses it up (aeWETH via ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).
Uses up the signer's current permit nonce, so an older permit with the same nonce no longer works.
The signature only works until `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)). It moves no tokens by itself. The spender can later move up to `value` WETH out of the signer's account.
formats.shown: The intent reads "Authorize spending of tokens". The fields show the spender (raw address), the max spending amount in WETH (the token comes from the verifying contract, and values of 2^255 or more show as "Unlimited"), the expiry date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.
